verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has a broad documented API. It covers customers, screening, case and alert remediation, monitoring configuration, exports, audit trails, roles and transactions, and the docs state that cases, alerts and risks can be handled either in the web app or through the API. There is no explicit UI-parity claim, though, and API credentials are generated and permissioned in the web application. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for creating API credentials, configuring risk-score equations and setting up screening configurations, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
The schema documents customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources.
This endpoint allows you to set the monitoring configuration for a single customer.
